name: Bench: DetectAndStyleAbstract preserves a caller's ScreenUpdating state

operation.value:
Dim d As Document
Set d = ActiveDocument
d.TrackRevisions = False
d.Content.Text = "Introduction heading" & vbCr & "This paragraph is the abstract of the article. It is written entirely in italics so that the detector recognizes it as the abstract of the submission and applies the abstract style to it without any manual review being needed by the editors of the journal." & vbCr & "Body text follows here."
d.Paragraphs(2).Range.Font.Italic = True
Application.Run "ProgressBar_Start", 1
Application.ScreenUpdating = False
Application.Run "DetectAndStyleAbstract"
Dim after As Boolean
after = Application.ScreenUpdating
Application.Run "ProgressBar_End"
Application.ScreenUpdating = True
Evaluate = Array(after, d.Paragraphs(2).Style.NameLocal)
